item.title: Version 1.2.1
item.description:
What's new

  • Calendar: fixed moving and resizing. Drag the middle of an event to move it without changing its length; drag the top edge to change only the start, or the bottom edge to change only the end.
  • Calendar: double-click an event to edit it. Right-click an event for Get Info, Edit, Join Meeting, Calendar, Cut, Copy, Paste, Duplicate, Star, Convert to, Email Event and Delete.
  • Calendar: drag on empty space to draw a new event, or double-click empty space for a one-hour event. Right-click empty space for New Event, New Task Here and Paste Event.
  • Calendar: with an event selected, Delete removes it, Return edits it, ⌘D duplicates it, and ⌘C, ⌘X and ⌘V copy, cut and paste. ⌘Z undoes moves, edits, new events and deletions.
  • Calendar: Option-drag copies an event to a new time, and Escape cancels a drag.
  • Calendar: repeating events ask whether to change only this event or all future events.
  • Calendar: the event editor now has Repeat and Alert.
  • Calendar: in the month view, double-click a day to add an event and drag an event to another day to move it.
  • Calendar: taller events show their location or meeting link, and the selected event is highlighted.
